description: Accelerator the company went through, as a lowercase code, or none. Y Combinator batches use YC's own code from the company page: yc- plus season letter and two-digit year (w winter, s summer, f fall; spring is x for 2025 and p from 2026), e.g. yc-w24, yc-p26. Other programs use the program code from `programs`, plus -yyyy for the cohort year when a primary page states it, e.g. techstars-2023, hf0, ef-2022. One value per row: the YC batch if there is one, else the earliest program. A program not in `programs` is added here first.
